```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r load-data}
con = DBI::dbConnect(
  RSQLite::SQLite(),
  "../data/midwest_airbnb_extended.db"
)

listings = DBI::dbReadTable(con, "listings") |>
  tibble::as_tibble()

availability = DBI::dbReadTable(con, "availability_monthly") |>
  tibble::as_tibble()

reviews = DBI::dbReadTable(con, "reviews_monthly") |>
  tibble::as_tibble()

DBI::dbDisconnect(con)

dim(listings)
dim(availability)
dim(reviews)
```

## Task 1

```{r task-1}
# Count each host's listings across all three cities
host_counts = listings |>
  dplyr::count(host_id, name = "host_listings")

# A1: Number of hosts with 10 or more listings
large_hosts = host_counts |>
  dplyr::filter(host_listings >= 10)

large_hosts |>
  dplyr::summarize(hosts_with_10_or_more = dplyr::n())

# Join host counts back to individual listings
listings_with_hosts = listings |>
  dplyr::left_join(host_counts, by = "host_id")

# Percentage of each city's listings held by those hosts
city_shares = listings_with_hosts |>
  dplyr::group_by(city) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    total_listings = dplyr::n(),
    large_host_listings = sum(host_listings >= 10),
    percent = 100 * large_host_listings / total_listings,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

city_shares

# A2: Chicago's percentage
city_shares |>
  dplyr::filter(city == "Chicago")
```

## Task 1

```{r task-1}
host_counts = listings |>
  dplyr::count(host_id, name = "host_listings")

large_hosts = host_counts |>
  dplyr::filter(host_listings >= 10)

# A1
large_hosts |>
  dplyr::summarize(A1 = dplyr::n())

listings_with_hosts = listings |>
  dplyr::left_join(host_counts, by = "host_id")

city_shares = listings_with_hosts |>
  dplyr::group_by(city) |>
  dplyr::summarize(

# All cities, also needed for B2
city_shares

city_shares |>
  dplyr::filter(city == "Chicago") |>
  dplyr::select(A2 = percent)
```

## Task 2

```{r task-2}
family_value = listings |>
  dplyr::filter(
    room_type == "Entire home/apt",
    accommodates >= 4,
    number_of_reviews >= 10,
    review_scores_rating >= 4.8
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    price_per_person = price / accommodates
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(city, neighbourhood) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    qualifying_listings = dplyr::n(),
    median_price_per_person = median(
      price_per_person, na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(qualifying_listings >= 20)

# A3: Returns all tied neighbourhoods if there is a tie
family_value |>
  dplyr::filter(city == "Columbus") |>
  dplyr::slice_min(
    median_price_per_person,
    n = 1,
    with_ties = TRUE
  )
```
```{r}
family_value |>
  dplyr::filter(city == "Columbus") |>
  dplyr::slice_min(
    median_price_per_person,
    n = 1,
    with_ties = TRUE
  )
```

## Task 3

```{r task-3}
earnings = listings |>
  dplyr::group_by(city, room_type) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    dplyr::across(
      c(price, reviews_per_month, estimated_revenue_l365d),
      ~ median(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
      .names = "median_{.col}"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

earnings

# A4
earnings |>
  dplyr::filter(
    city == "Twin Cities",
    room_type == "Entire home/apt"
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(A4 = median_estimated_revenue_l365d)
```

## Task 4

```{r task-4}
ranked_revenue = listings |>
  dplyr::group_by(city) |>
  dplyr::arrange(
    dplyr::desc(estimated_revenue_l365d),
    .by_group = TRUE
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    top_10_percent = dplyr::row_number() <=
      ceiling(0.10 * dplyr::n())
  ) |>
  dplyr::ungroup()

revenue_shares = ranked_revenue |>
  dplyr::group_by(city) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    total_revenue = sum(
      estimated_revenue_l365d, na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    top_10_revenue = sum(
      estimated_revenue_l365d[top_10_percent],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    percent = 100 * top_10_revenue / total_revenue,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# All cities, also needed for B2
revenue_shares

# A5
revenue_shares |>
  dplyr::filter(city == "Columbus") |>
  dplyr::select(A5 = percent)
```

## Task 5

```{r task-5}
october_availability = availability |>
  dplyr::filter(month == "2026-10")

october_homes = listings |>
  dplyr::filter(room_type == "Entire home/apt") |>
  dplyr::inner_join(october_availability, by = "id") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    mostly_taken = nights_available < 0.5 * nights_in_month
  )

taken_shares = october_homes |>
  dplyr::group_by(city) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    matched_homes = dplyr::n(),
    share = mean(mostly_taken, na.rm = TRUE),
    percent = 100 * share,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

taken_shares

# A6 and A7
taken_shares |>
  dplyr::slice_min(share, n = 1, with_ties = TRUE) |>
  dplyr::select(A6 = city, A7_share = share, A7_percent = percent)
```

## Task 6

```{r task-6}
monthly_demand = reviews |>
  dplyr::inner_join(
    listings |> dplyr::select(id, city),
    by = "id"
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(
    month >= "2025-07",
    month <= "2026-06"
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(city, month) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    total_reviews = sum(reviews, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

twin_cities_demand = monthly_demand |>
  dplyr::filter(city == "Twin Cities") |>
  dplyr::arrange(month)

twin_cities_demand

# A8
twin_cities_demand |>
  dplyr::slice_max(total_reviews, n = 1, with_ties = TRUE) |>
  dplyr::select(A8 = month, total_reviews)

# A9
twin_cities_demand |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    busiest_reviews = max(total_reviews),
    quietest_reviews = min(total_reviews),
    A9 = busiest_reviews / quietest_reviews
  )
```

## Task 7

```{r task-7}
superhost_summary = listings |>
  dplyr::filter(
    room_type == "Entire home/apt",
    host_is_superhost %in% c("t", "f")
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(city, host_is_superhost) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    listings_count = dplyr::n(),
    median_price = median(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_rating = median(review_scores_rating, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

superhost_summary

superhost_premiums = superhost_summary |>
  dplyr::group_by(city) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    superhost_median_price =
      median_price[host_is_superhost == "t"],
    other_host_median_price =
      median_price[host_is_superhost == "f"],
    premium_dollars =
      superhost_median_price - other_host_median_price,
    superhost_median_rating =
      median_rating[host_is_superhost == "t"],
    other_host_median_rating =
      median_rating[host_is_superhost == "f"],
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Three premiums and ratings for B1
superhost_premiums
```

## Task 8

```{r task-8}
missing_availability = listings |>
  dplyr::anti_join(availability, by = "id")

# A10
missing_availability |>
  dplyr::summarize(A10 = dplyr::n())

missing_by_city = missing_availability |>
  dplyr::count(city, name = "missing_listings") |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(missing_listings))

missing_by_city

# City that loses the most, for your README
missing_by_city |>
  dplyr::slice_max(missing_listings, n = 1, with_ties = TRUE)
```

## B1: The badge

```{r b1}
superhost_premiums |>
  dplyr::select(
    city,
    premium_dollars,
    superhost_median_rating,
    other_host_median_rating
  )

# Another number to check: estimated revenue by Superhost status
listings |>
  dplyr::filter(
    city == "Twin Cities",
    room_type == "Entire home/apt",
    host_is_superhost %in% c("t", "f")
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(host_is_superhost) |>
  dplyr::summarize(
    median_estimated_revenue = median(
      estimated_revenue_l365d, na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

cap_comparison = city_shares |>
